text.offer: Tova says, "Before you go looking for trouble in Marion, get yourself something heavier to swing. Colhorr at the smithy, Ye Olde Slasher Salesman, sells a good mace for next to nothing. Tell him I sent you: he owes me for a few barrels, and he'll put some coin in your hand for it. Then buy yourself a mace."
text.progress: Colhorr keeps the smithy in Marion, Ye Olde Slasher Salesman. Right-click him and choose Quests to talk to him, and Buy to see what he sells.
text.complete: Colhorr says, "A fine choice. Mind you keep it out of the bar - Tova's furniture has suffered enough."

steps.brief: Colhorr says, "Tova sent you, did he? Then a mace it is. Right-click me and choose Buy, and tick the mace."
